seo.title: Rocket League Tryouts
seo.description: Find out how the Crow6 eSports Rocket League player selection works and join our Discord to learn when the next tryouts open.

open.title: JOIN CROW 6
open.desc: We are looking for committed players who want to compete at the highest level. The process is serious; if you are not willing to put in the effort, this is not your team.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: How to reach you and when you can train.

technical.title: Level
technical.desc: Your current level, your playstyle and where to watch your games.

mindset.title: Mindset
mindset.desc: How you compete as a team. Be honest.

discord.label: Discord username
discord.hint: Your username, not your display name. We will contact you here.

competitive_exp.label: Do you have experience in competitive teams?

previous_teams.label: Which teams have you been in?

reaction_mistakes.label: How do you react when a teammate makes a repeated mistake?

reaction_losses.label: How do you react to a losing streak?

options.calm: I stay calm and keep going

looking_for.label: What are you looking for in Crow 6 eSports?
looking_for.placeholder: What do you expect from the team?

open_to_coaching.label: Are you open to receiving coaching or doing VOD reviews?

validation.reaction_mistakes_required: Answer too short: at least 10 characters
validation.looking_for_required: Answer too short: at least 10 characters
validation.discord_invalid: Use your Discord username: 2 to 32 characters, only letters, numbers, _ and .
validation.birth_date_invalid: Enter a valid date of birth
validation.hours_invalid: Enter a whole number of hours
validation.schedule_same_time: The end time must differ from the start time

error.submit_failed: We could not send your application. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.rate_limited: You have sent too many applications in a row. Wait a few minutes before trying again.

success.title: APPLICATION SENT
success.desc: We have received your application. We review each application personally. If you fit what we are looking for, we will contact you via Discord within 7 days.
success.note: If you do not receive a response within 7 days, your application has not been selected for this call.

closed.title: TRYOUTS CLOSED
closed.desc: There is no open process right now. Follow us on Discord and we will let you know when the next one opens.

seo.title: Rocket League Coaching
seo.description: Rocket League coaching with {years} years of experience: 1on1 and team sessions with the Crow 6 Head Coach. Individual from {price}/month.

coaching.title: Coaching
coaching.description: Rank up with replay reviews, clear goals every session and a weekly plan that fits your schedule.

plans.title: Coaching packs
plans.lead: All packs are monthly and each tier includes everything in the one before.
plans.sessions_one: {count} weekly session of {hours} h · {monthly} h a month
plans.sessions_other: {count} weekly sessions of {hours} h · {monthly} h a month

individual.live_review: Review of your replays during the session

single.title: Single sessions
single.lead: Start with a free intro session. And if you sign up for a pack within {days} days of a paid session, we deduct what you paid.

intro.title: Intro session
intro.description: 30 min to get to know each other, look at your level and goals, and recommend the pack that suits you best. No commitment.

live.title: 1-on-1 session
live.description: {hours} h live with the coach to work on something specific: a mechanic, a losing streak or a tournament.

replay_review.title: Replay review
replay_review.description: Send a match and get an analysis with the key points to improve, no scheduling needed.

team_live.title: Team session
team_live.description: {hours} h with your team to prepare for a tournament or fix a specific gameplay problem.
